articles.title: Kiekhaefer Mercury Hurricane Super 10 at No Reserve
articles.summary: This article details the Mercury KG-7Q Super 10 Hurricane, a classic two-stroke parallel-twin outboard motor. Built in 1951 by Kiekhaefer Mercury, this 10-horsepower engine is described as being part of a seller's collection. It highlights the design and specifications of a vintage piece of marine engineering, showcasing historical advancements in motor technology from the mid-20th century.

articles.title: A New Study Narrows the Search for Water on the Moon
articles.summary: India's Chandrayaan-1 mission, through its Moon Impact Probe (MIP), confirmed a long-held scientific speculation upon impacting the Shackleton crater. This landmark achievement solidified India's role in space exploration, providing crucial insights into the lunar environment. The mission's findings, likely related to the presence of water ice, are vital for future lunar resource utilization and establishing human presence on the Moon.

articles.title: Show HN: Farchive – SQLite-backed history-preserving compressed archive
articles.summary: Farchive is a local, history-preserving digital archive designed for managing opaque bytes at specified locators. It efficiently stores raw data once, uniquely identified by its SHA-256 digest, while maintaining a complete observation history for each locator. This system ensures robust data integrity and traceability, crucial for managing and retrieving complex digital information in various technical applications.

articles.title: GE Aerospace-IAF tie up for depo-level maintenance iof F404 -IN20 engines
articles.summary: GE Aerospace has contracted with the Indian Air Force to establish an in-country depot facility for the maintenance of F404-IN20 engines. These engines power the IAF's Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas. This move enhances India's indigenous maintenance capabilities, reduces foreign dependence for critical aircraft components, and significantly boosts the operational readiness and self-reliance of the Indian Air Force.
